name: Amethyst Phial
summary: Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Amethyst Phial to travelers in Dolanaar. They carry it to the Oracle Glade to gather water from the moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree.

sections.title: Vessel of Sacred Waters
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Amethyst Phial to travelers on Teldrassil. It is the final vessel used in the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage. They carry it to the far northwest of the boughs, to the Oracle Glade. Beneath the ancient canopy of the Oracle Tree lies the island’s first and most potent moonwell. The phial is dipped into its radiant waters to gather the essence of Elune’s grace. Druids and priestesses study and tend to the World Tree’s unpredictable growth with that water.

sections.title: A Burden of Unblessed Growth
sections.body: Teldrassil was raised under the guidance of Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, without the blessings of the Dragon Aspects. They refused to endorse what they considered an act of arrogance. As a consequence, the boughs suffer from unsettling corruption, and the kaldorei remain mortal. Filling the Amethyst Phial is both a spiritual rite and an ongoing survey. Researchers in Dolanaar scrutinize the purity of Teldrassil’s sacred waters.

faq.q: What is the Amethyst Phial used for?
aliases: what do i do with amethyst phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage gives the phial to travelers to gather water from Teldrassil’s first and most potent moonwell, beneath the Oracle Tree in the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Where do I fill the Amethyst Phial?
faq.answer: Fill it in the moonwell far northwest of Dolanaar, north of the entrance to Darnassus, in the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Why is the water from the Oracle Glade so important?
faq.answer: The moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree is considered the first and most potent well on the World Tree. Its waters carry the essence of Elune and help researchers monitor Teldrassil’s spiritual and physical health.

faq.q: Who sends you to use this phial?
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, a night elf druid in Dolanaar, gives you the phial for a ritual meant to understand Teldrassil’s troubled growth.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you take on a solemn duty when you fill the phial, confronting the flaws in Teldrassil’s unblessed creation.
As a druid, you use the phial to monitor the World Tree’s vital energies and creeping corruption.

attribution: Teldrassil: The Burden of the Kaldorei
